averaging_units.entity_macro: the statistic the CI is built for and the one the interval covers
averaging_units.row_micro: the published hierarchy_metrics rate; the two differ because entities contribute unequal numbers of probes, so subtracting two published rates does not reproduce the CI's centre

analysis.ci_unit: entity - the iNaturalist species or the MLLMU person - which is the unit the bootstrap resamples

b0_is_the_no_op.consequence: MF is excluded from the confirmation because B0 is a byte-identical copy of it, measured here rather than inherited from 11R's output comparison

B0.role: the no-op comparator: B3-vs-B0 carries TGA superiority and FILR reduction, and the descriptive retention intervals

B3.role: subject of both primary claims and of every descriptive interval

MG.role: the granularity oracle, DESCRIPTIVE only: its interval is published with an explicit statement that equivalence is NOT concluded

claims.evidence: preregistration_decisions in the power report bound above

code.why_analysis_scripts_are_bound_separatel: CODE_FINGERPRINT_MODULES binds the modules that turn queries into scores. These turn scores into claims, and an edit to either would change what the frozen protocol means without changing a single prediction - so the sidecars would still verify while the conclusion moved.

exploratory_dataset.role: the dataset the checkpoints were SELECTED on. It is bound here to prove what the confirmation is not: the confirmation split is a different dataset whose own hashes are committed at stage 4, and no query in it may overlap this one.
exploratory_dataset.selection_basis: train+val probes only (test split held out)

generation.batch_layout: ONE uniform layout for every scored state: all confirmation queries in a single pass, same batch_size and image_batch_size for B3, B0 and MG. Batched greedy decoding is not bit-stable across batch compositions, so two layouts would put decoding noise inside the paired difference itself.
generation.source: the single generation_config shared by all 30 committed 11R predictions

purpose: Bind every parameter the confirmatory claims depend on before any confirmation probe is built or scored, so that a result produced afterwards cannot be explained by a parameter that moved beforehand.

equivalence_margin.margin_rationale: prespecified: one third of the 0.15 separation the reference-state gate requires between MF/MG/MN
equivalence_margin.role: REPORTING YARDSTICK, not a tested margin
equivalence_margin.what_it_is_used_for: the published half-widths are read against it and the reports state whether an interval could have concluded equivalence at it; no TOST and no non-inferiority test is run against it on the confirmation split
equivalence_margin.why: both margin claims were demoted by the 11C-2a decisions, so there is no hypothesis test left for this margin to serve

sealed_split_invariants.enforced_by: the stage-3 probe builder, by hash and by query_id, before the split is written
sealed_split_invariants.invariant: no confirmation query_id, association, paraphrase template or photograph appears in the exploratory dataset bound above
sealed_split_invariants.why: the reference-state gate inspected the exploratory test split before candidate selection, which is why those results stay exploratory; a confirmation probe reused from that split inherits the exposure

sealed_split_invariants.enforced_by: evaluate_reference_states.py is pointed at the exploratory data_dir only; the freeze records that data_dir here
sealed_split_invariants.invariant: the confirmation split never enters the reference-state gate
sealed_split_invariants.why: the gate is a go/no-go on the oracle, and letting it see confirmation data would make the confirmation exploratory in the same way

sealed_split_invariants.enforced_by: select_unlearning_checkpoints.py keeps selection_scope train+val on the exploratory dataset; no confirmation artifact is an input to it
sealed_split_invariants.invariant: the confirmation split never enters candidate selection or any other go/no-go decision
sealed_split_invariants.why: selection is already complete and frozen; re-running it on confirmation data would be selecting on the test set

sealed_split_invariants.enforced_by: the stage-5 runner assembles only after all states' sidecars verify; crashes resume through verified sidecars alone
sealed_split_invariants.invariant: partial state results are not inspected before every scored state has finished
sealed_split_invariants.why: looking at B3 before MG has run is how a layout or scoring change gets made mid-flight and the score-exactly-once property is lost

sealed_split_invariants.enforced_by: this freeze, plus the analysis-script hashes bound above: a retune changes those hashes
sealed_split_invariants.invariant: a failed primary claim is reported as failed
sealed_split_invariants.why: retuning on confirmation data converts a confirmatory result back into an exploratory one

excluded.B1: not the subject of any preregistered claim
excluded.B2: not the subject of any preregistered claim
excluded.B2R: not the subject of any preregistered claim
excluded.BASE: no confirmation claim references the un-finetuned model
excluded.MF: excluded only if the measured adapter contract proves B0 IS the no-op copy of it; see b0_is_the_no_op. If that check fails the freeze refuses rather than dropping a distinct state.
excluded.MN: the negative-control oracle carries no confirmation claim

scored_because.B0: the no-op comparator: B3-vs-B0 carries TGA superiority and FILR reduction, and the descriptive retention intervals
scored_because.B3: subject of both primary claims and of every descriptive interval
scored_because.MG: the granularity oracle, DESCRIPTIVE only: its interval is published with an explicit statement that equivalence is NOT concluded
